summary: Iter-192 — Week-off trash bug fix + Onboarding module_locks + Lock Notice Toast verified end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest 6/6 pass, /app/backend/tests/test_iter192_weekoff_onboarding.py): (1) DELETE /api/week-off-requests/{id}: seeded {status:'approved'} → GET /api/week-off-requests?status=all lists it, DELETE → {ok:true}, second DELETE → 404, DELETE on seeded {status:'pending'} → 400 'Approve or reject this request instead of deleting it'. (2) POST /api/super-admin/tenants {slug:'qa-onboard-locks-2', plan:'starter', module_locks:['cctv','reports','not-a-module']} → 200 with temp_password + must_change_password:true. GET /api/super-admin/tenants/{id}/features → entitlements.module_locks=['cctv','reports'] (bogus dropped), entitlements.locked contains both, entitlements.grandfathered=false. Owner login with temp password required change-password call first, then GET /api/cctv/config → 403 {detail:'MODULE_LOCKED', module:'cctv'}; GET /api/appointments → 200. Cleaned up via DELETE /api/super-admin/tenants/{id}/permanent?confirm=<slug> for both qa-onboard-locks-2 AND leftover qa-lock-salon-x1 (afdeb54d-310c-4a65-bfd0-eb2903cdd166 — was already gone at test end). FRONTEND Playwright: (a) INR owner /attendance: seeded [approved-week-off-<id>] visible under 'Previous decisions'; [delete-week-off-<id>] opens ConfirmDialog with exact title 'Remove this week-off record?'; Cancel keeps the row (count remains 1); confirm removes the row, toast 'Removed from history' appears, reload confirms persistence (count=0). (b) SA /super-admin → Tenants → [super-new-tenant-btn] opens [onboard-tenant-modal] with [onboard-module-picker] containing exactly 23 [onboard-module-*] checkboxes all initially ticked; [onboard-modules-all], [onboard-modules-tier-starter|professional|premium|enterprise] all present. Click [onboard-modules-tier-starter] unticks exactly the 11 modules per spec (assistant, attendance, cctv, hire, inventory, mira-studio, offers-studio, receptionist, registry, reports, staff-activities) and header shows '11 locked'. All features re-ticks all 23. Manually unticking [onboard-module-cctv] shows '1 locked'. Cancel closes modal without submitting. (c) Regression: SA reset glow-studio-austin module_locks=[] confirmed via features endpoint; INR owner /api/products → 200 and /api/appointments → 200 (no MODULE_LOCKED). Lock toast interceptor code path confirmed via code review of /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (lines 113-123): 403 MODULE_LOCKED shows sonner.warning ‘“<module>” isn't in your plan yet — upgrade to unlock it’ with 'See plans' action → window.location.assign('/settings#subscription'); reviewed and asserted the endpoint returns detail:'MODULE_LOCKED' & module:<name> at top level (verified in backend test).

integration_issues.issue: Sonner toast rendering could not be visually asserted end-to-end from Playwright because the 'What's New' modal appears on first /reviews load (opaque overlay) and the toast auto-dismisses after ~4s. Text 'See plans' was found in the DOM but from the module upgrade-gate/plan card, not the toast — clicking it did not navigate. Backend gating (403 MODULE_LOCKED + module) is fully verified in pytest and api.js interceptor code (lines 113-123) is correct; recommend a small e2e fix: expose data-testid='module-lock-toast' on the sonner content to make it uniquely selectable.

issues: 'What's New' modal auto-reopens on every load until user clicks 'Got it' — no localStorage suppression flag; combined with the passkey nudge modal this stacks TWO opaque overlays on top of Dashboard/Attendance/Reviews and blocks first-click interactions for automation and slow-typing users.

action_items: Consider adding data-testid on the sonner MODULE_LOCKED toast root (e.g. data-testid='module-lock-toast' with an inner 'see-plans' button testid) so the toast can be uniquely e2e-verified.

Persist 'What's New' modal dismissal in localStorage keyed by version so it isn't re-shown on every route change — currently blocks first-click interactions until 'Got it' is pressed on every full-page load.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/staff_portal.py delete_week_off_request: correct guard — 404 on missing, 400 on pending, deletes only decided (approved/rejected) records with audit trail. No tenant scoping filter in the find_one — relies on require_tenant_admin dependency scoping; harmless because ids are UUIDs but adding {'tenant_id': admin['tenant_id']} would prevent cross-tenant leakage if id were guessed. LOW risk.

routes/super_admin_ops.py create_tenant: module_locks filtered via `if m in MODULES` — bogus 'not-a-module' silently dropped, no error to caller. Confirms spec. temp_password returned once in response body only — safe.

components/superadmin/ModuleAccessPicker.jsx: header text '(0 locked)' with '0' is grammatically awkward; consider hiding the counter when 0. matchTier function assumes tier_modules[tier] exists — a stale tier param logs no warning but silently returns []. Minor.

components/superadmin/OnboardTenantModal.jsx: PLANS = [starter/pro/enterprise] but the module picker preset uses [starter/professional/premium/enterprise] — 'pro' vs 'professional' mismatch means the tier prop passed to picker won't highlight the preset button when Pro plan is selected. Consider aligning naming or mapping pro→professional.

lib/api.js interceptor: `api._lastLockToast` throttle window is 4s — good, prevents duplicate toasts from waterfall requests. `See plans` action goes to `/settings#subscription` which matches product intent (spec said /settings — matches).
routes/staff_portal.py:239 `my_week_off_requests` returns list directly (not paginated) with .to_list(50) — same pattern used elsewhere. Fine for MVP.

confirmAsync: renders via createPortal to document.body with `data-testid=confirm-dialog` on the outer div that also has onClick={onClose}; a stray outside click could unintentionally cancel — pointerdown/pointerup on the same element would be safer than click for dismiss detection.

PasskeyNudge + WhatsNewModal: both are un-suppressible without localStorage/API acknowledgement; the WhatsNewModal has NO dismissal-persistence at all (re-shown every page load). Blocks Playwright and first-click UX.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — week-off delete UI + onboarding module picker fully verified; lock toast interceptor verified at API layer and via code review but visual sonner toast could not be uniquely selected due to overlapping 'What's New' modal + short auto-dismiss (no data-testid on toast).
